title: Mathematical Methods Iii
mcq: Fill in the blank: ______ is one of the best methods used in handling problems involving mechanical vibrations.
The integral transform method is one of the best methods used in handling problems involving mechanical vibrations.
Fill in the blank: ______ is defined to be the inverse operation of addition.
Subtraction is defined to be the inverse operation of addition.
Fill in the blank: ______ is a method for solving differential equations and corresponding initial and boundary value problems.
The Laplace transform is a method for solving differential equations and corresponding initial and boundary value problems.

Fill in the blank: ______ is one of the most equations in physics, occurring in gravitation, electrostatics, fluid flow, etc. (cf. chaps. 11, 17) let us discover why this equation arises in complex analysis.

Laplace's equation is one of the most equations in physics, occurring in gravitation, electrostatics, fluid flow, etc. (cf. chaps. 11, 17) let us discover why this equation arises in complex analysis.

Fill in the blank: ______ is a functional determinant (whose elements are functions) which is very useful in transformation of variables from Cartesian to polar, cylindrical and spherical coordinates in multiple integras.

Jacobian is a functional determinant (whose elements are functions) which is very useful in transformation of variables from Cartesian to polar, cylindrical and spherical coordinates in multiple integras.
Fill in the blank: ______ is a function whose derivative equals a given analytic function in a region.
An indefinite integral is a function whose derivative equals a given analytic function in a region.
Fill in the blank: ______ is called the derivative of v(t ).
The vector is called the derivative of v(t ) .
fib: ______ are the same as in real calculus, since their proofs are literally the same.
differentiation rules
The differentiation rules are the same as in real calculus, since their proofs are literally the same.
______ is called closed if its complement is open.
set
A set is called closed if its complement is open.
______ is a set consisting of a domain plus, perhaps, some or all of its boundary points.
region
A region is a set consisting of a domain plus, perhaps, some or all of its boundary points.
______ is an ordered pair (x, y) of real numbers x, y and we write z = ( x, y).
complex number z
A complex number z is an ordered pair (x, y) of real numbers x, y and we write z = ( x, y).
______ is defined to be the inverse operation of multiplication.
Division
Division is defined to be the inverse operation of multiplication.
______ is a unit normal vector of S and, also dr is the unit tangent vector ds and S the arc length of C.
ds where n
ds where n is a unit normal vector of S and, also dr is the unit tangent vector ds and S the arc length of C.
______ is called the domain of definition of f.
set S
The set S is called the domain of definition of f.
